name: Paystack
about: An African payments provider, owned by Stripe, for accepting online and in-person payments through an API.

facts.note: The documentation names these five. The home page also offers a private beta in Côte d'Ivoire, Egypt and Rwanda; Egypt and Rwanda aren't in the documentation's list, so they are left out.
Official SDKs: InlineJS, Node.js, Python, iOS (Swift/Objective-C), Android (Kotlin/Java) and Flutter (mapped to Dart); community libraries are excluded.
Audited as a PCI DSS 3.2 Level 1 service provider; the page makes no ISO 27001 or SOC 2 claim.
